description: US mega-cap earnings: when a company reports, whether that date is confirmed or still an estimate, whether it prints before the open or after the close, the consensus EPS, and once it lands the reported EPS with the beat or miss. Pass symbol for one name, like AAPL. This is the tool for any question about a company's earnings date or EPS.

fresh.description: Set true to ask for the live view of this one call, for 5 credits, where the connected account otherwise receives it an hour behind. Accepted and free where the account is already live. No effect without a key.

symbol.description: One or more tickers, comma separated, like AAPL or AAPL,MSFT. Empty returns every name tracked.

name: get_earnings
title: Mega-cap earnings dates and EPS
